summary.headline: Impediments to Peasants and King
summary.text: Chapters 43–44 of Māshāʾallāh’s astrological treatise explain how combustion of the ascendant’s lord in angular places signifies impediments to peasants, varying by sign gender, planet, age, and oriental or occidental position. The following chapter judges dangers to the king from Mars, Saturn, combustion, conjunctions, aspects, and the angles in a year’s revolution.
